---
title: Absolute table of contents links
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        document.querySelectorAll('#TOC a[href^="#"]').forEach(function (link) {
          link.href = link.href;
        });
        </script>
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: expert
        shown: false
        label: Expert
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The table of contents entry of a hidden section hides when Quarto makes its link absolute.
        check: "node veil-check.mjs"
---
